instruction.name: vexth.qu.du
instruction.description: Zero-extend 64-bit elements in the higher half of every 128-bit vector of `a` to 128-bit.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 1.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vexth.qu.du $vr0, $vr8; vexth.qu.du $vr1, $vr9; vexth.qu.du $vr2, $vr10; vexth.qu.du $vr3, $vr11; vexth.qu.du $vr4, $vr12; vexth.qu.du $vr5, $vr13; vexth.qu.du $vr6, $vr14; vexth.qu.du $vr7, $vr15
